name: Adjuvant Pack: Cisplatin + Lomustine (CCNU) + Vincristine (Pediatric Medulloblastoma)

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric CNS Tumors v1.2026

supportiveCare: Pre- and post-hydration with mannitol/furosemide as needed
monitoring: CBC with differential weekly (CCNU has delayed 4-6 week platelet/WBC nadir)

drugs.name: CISplatin
drugs.notes: CISplatin 75 mg/m2 IV over 6 hours with vigorous hydration on Day 1.

drugs.name: Lomustine (CCNU)
drugs.notes: Lomustine 75 mg/m2 PO once on Day 1 at bedtime (delayed myelosuppression nadir at week 4-5).

drugs.name: vinCRIStine
drugs.notes: vinCRIStine 1.5 mg/m2 (cap 2 mg) IV push on Days 1, 8, 15. Fatal if given intrathecally. IV only.
